title: distichorchis revoluta
intro: Distichorchis revoluta, commonly known as the Yellow Orchid, is a type of flowering plant in the orchid family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Distichorchis revoluta include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
